data.body: Classification: llm-behavioral. Investigation (inline): ROOT_CAUSE: The story-merge bash block (lines 2162-2205) has correct if/else logic for ci-pr vs local mode, but the LLM orchestrator ignores the SPRINT_MODE check and defaults to the simpler local-mode path. No HARD-GATE exists around this code block to force attention. Fix: add a HARD-GATE tag before the merge step that explicitly names the prohibited action in ci-pr mode, mirroring the bug 2dcb fix pattern. Confidence: MEDIUM (behavioral fixes have uncertain impact but this pattern has worked for similar bugs).
